relations: The central white smoke cloud diffuses at its edges and expands slightly upward while maintaining its overall position.
The grey haze near the left tree line drifts faintly across the snow-covered clearing.
The scattered bright airborne specks increase in density, forming a heavy speckled field against the pale sky.
Orange points flash briefly among the trees in varying locations before fading out.
caption: The video captures a snow-covered clearing bordered by tall pine trees beneath a pale sky, with a dense white smoke cloud already occupying the center-right of the frame. The camera remains fixed, so the treeline and horizon hold steady while the smoke plume changes shape, becoming more diffuse at its edges and extending slightly upward and sideways. A thinner grey haze lingers along the left tree line, drifting faintly across the open ground. Small bright specks are scattered through the air, and their density increases noticeably as the view continues, forming a heavy speckled field against the sky and foreground. Occasional orange points flash briefly among the trees, appearing in different spots before fading. The white cloud does not move as a rigid body; it keeps roughly the same position over the snow while its outline softens. No source, impact, or operator is visible, and the process remains active throughout the visible portion. The scene stays centered on the changing smoke, the bright airborne particles, and the quiet winter clearing around them.
